title: D-024 D: controller state machine, safe seams, exact-once succession, outage handling
objective: Extend the existing durable state machine to the full section-3 state set with renewable epoch leases; pause/resume/graceful-stop/emergency-stop precedence (owner stop intent survives restart and wins over queued/recovered work); safe-seam detection and handoff validation per section 7 (atomic batches, known lease ownership, recorded checks, no unanswered permission, external effects confirmed/not-attempted/ambiguous-marked, children reconciled, smallest-complete handoff packet, no silent truncation); exact-once primary-session rotation and controller-crash reconciliation (lease races have exactly one winner; watchdog restart without duplicates; bounded read-only orientation for new sessions while children drain); host-restart auto-resume via the repository's approved user-level startup mechanism or truthful activation-blocker reporting; Codex transport preflight (version-probed, structured, read-only, schema-validated, identity-bound, fail-closed - missing/malformed/timed-out/mismatched decisions dispatch nothing) with bounded-backoff durable retry for transient failures and blocked-with-handoff for auth/billing/compatibility failures; no-eligible-work bounded idle. Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R102 (Phase D).
business_reason: D-024 sections 2, 3, 7, 15-D, 16.3: continuity must be a renewable sequence of bounded epochs with exact-once succession, never an immortal process.
outputs: tools/test_agent_supervisor_controller_succession.py (section 16.3 matrix incl. Gate-0 recovery cases, crash windows, lease races, stop-intent persistence)
